resolved_conflicts.explanation: Not resolved. Register puts the Bald Knob Lookout Site in Hardin County at 37.558, -88.335. Regional listings put the Bald Knob lookout in Union County at 37.55182, -89.34614 and list no Bald Knob among Hardin County sites. Latitudes differ by under 0.01 degree; longitudes differ by about a degree. Possibly a mis-keyed duplicate of US 2061 or a separate tower; undecided.

notes_for_editor: Unresolved location. The Hardin County record (US 2065) has no matching Hardin County Bald Knob in the regional listings, which place Bald Knob in Union County (US 2061). Check the original nomination or a map before publishing a location. No corrections proposed because neither record is shown to be wrong. Two web searches found no Hardin County Bald Knob. No build date, builder, staffing or fire history found. Access unknown.
